author: Nerv102
quote: Extremely slow, jason was a very boring character. And Lucia was even worse. Not because she was boring but because she was Extremely annoying. Also why would you take out the fun stuff from other gta games and replace with relationship building and chores. This is a gta game not the Sims. Im so disappointed, especially for a 100 dollar game. And the other thing that annoys me is the fact there is protected classes that you cant hurt. Wtf is that? Do I have to remind you this is a game about crime? No hookers? Hell for a game called grand theft auto. Its awfully difficult to steal a nice car to drive around for how many hours into the game?? This was a giant fail. I should have known after all the original writers of the good gtas left Rockstar. And that is without even mentioningits 24-30 fps and all the bugs.
